criteria.label: Innovation & Operational Utility
criteria.reason: HealthIA now proves both sides of its agentic proposition. Gemini + Google ADK generate case-specific clinical interview blocks from accumulated patient context, while the live Vertex Taskmaster proof demonstrates a complete non-chat workflow: preserve the original PDF, spend one Gemini 3.5 Flash request on structured multimodal extraction, commit the result, update the provenance-linked clinical twin, retrieve the persisted study later, return its evidence, and close the result_explanation mission with correlated result/document IDs. The workflow remains useful after the model request ceiling is exhausted and the completed outcome survives patient logout/login while remaining isolated from a second identity. The remaining two points are reserved for judge-visible proof of the same autonomy on the deployed Cloud runtime and a polished live demo rather than additional feature breadth.

criteria.label: Architectural Discipline & Tech Stack
criteria.reason: The candidate uses typed patient-scoped state, deterministic safety, scrypt accounts, signed HttpOnly sessions, patient-scoped SSE, demand-driven Google ADK, signed device identity, atomic result-plus-original commits, a derived clinical twin, guarded model spend, Vertex AI through ADC, controlled JSON generation, and separate Cloud Build/runtime service identities. Live proofs already demonstrate authenticated two-patient isolation and durable result/mission continuity outside static mocks. One architecture point remains reserved until the exact candidate demonstrates Firestore/GCS persistence and isolation across a real Cloud Run revision/reconnect.

criteria.label: Demo & Production Readiness
criteria.reason: The evidence package now includes a live authenticated Gemini/ADK interview proof, a separate one-request Gemini 3.5 Flash Vertex Taskmaster proof, a judge-facing architecture, a four-minute demo script, strict Cloud deployment/readback tooling, and a current release candidate that passes pytest, fourteen full-system workflows, Chromium E2E, compile/smoke/Judge checks, frontend and PowerShell validation, release ZIP verification, and pytest again from the extracted ZIP. Google Cloud ADC is operational and a non-mutating IAM gate identifies the exact remaining provisioning permissions. The remaining five points are held for the actual Cloud Run + Firestore + GCS strict proof, revision/reconnect continuity, the unedited video, and final submission artifacts.

critical_blockers.statement: Google Cloud ADC and live Vertex execution are proven, and the repository has a fail-closed permission/deployment/verifier path, but the exact candidate has not yet produced a passing Cloud Run + Firestore + private GCS strict-proof artifact or revision/reconnect continuity evidence.
